title: Blackrock Pass
wikitext:
[[File:Blackrock Pass.jpg|thumb|300px|Blackrock Pass leading into Redridge Mountains.]]

'''Blackrock Pass''' is the main entrance into the [[Burning Steppes]] from the [[Redridge Mountains]], and it the only foot entrance to the Steppes other than through [[Blackrock Mountain]]. By traveling through the pass, you leave behind the tranquil low-level lands of the [[human]] starting areas and venture into the scorched and twisted ruin of the Burning Steppes. Low-level travelers are advised to avoid Blackrock Pass at all costs, as the enemies beyond are far stronger than those found in Redridge Mountains.

The pass contains a gate that borders Redridge Mountains.

A camp sits along the side of the road, formed by the exiled [[Dark Iron dwarves]] miners [[Orvak Sternrock]], [[Radgan Deepblaze]] and [[Morgrim Firepike]], who were cast out of the [[Shadowforge Miner's Union]] and the [[Hateforge Quarry]].
